subject: ggtree + unsupervised hierarchical clustering and metadata bar for gHeatmap

messages.author: 821b840500b24147
messages.subject: ggtree + unsupervised hierarchical clustering and metadata bar for gHeatmap
parts:
Hello,

I am wondering if it is possible to produce a dendrogram over a heatmap plotted with gheatmap(). This would be a useful function, if it is not possible at the moment. 

I would like to do two things that I haven't figured out:

1. Perform unsupervised hierarchical clustering on the columns of the heatmap, and have the dendrogram displayed on top of the heatmap, and

2. Add a bar below the columns of the heatmap with numerical metadata about the column (see the last row of the R code below). 

Below is a reproducible example that generates a phylogenetic tree and a heatmap from the GlobalPatterns dataset (see attached).

################ 
rm (list = ls())
library(phyloseq);library(ggstance);library(ggthemes);library(plyr)
library(dplyr);library(ggtree);library(tibble)

# Load sample Phyloseq dataset
data("GlobalPatterns")
GP <- GlobalPatterns
GP <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(GP) > 5000, GP) #just to make the number of OTUs smaller

mergedGP <- merge_samples(GP, "SampleType")
mergedGP <- rarefy_even_depth(mergedGP,rngseed=394582)

print(mergedGP) #final phyloseq object

#make a tree
tr <- phy_tree(mergedGP)
spec <- tax_table(mergedGP) %>% data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("otu")
gt <- ggtree(tr, branch.length = "y") %<+% spec 
gd <- gt$data

melt_data<-psmelt(mergedGP) 

randomHeatmap <- data.frame(replicate(20,sample(0:10000,630,rep=TRUE)))
rownames(randomHeatmap) <- spec$otu

################ 
# Make a simple dataframe to build the boxplots
melt_simple <- subset(melt_data,select=c(OTU,Sample,Abundance,Kingdom,Phylum))
melt_simple$randomGroup <- sample(2, size = nrow(melt_simple), replace = TRUE)
melt_simple$randomGroup <- as.factor(melt_simple$randomGroup)

t <- get.tax(mergedGP) %>% mutate(PhySpec=paste(Phylum,otu)) 
taxa_names(mergedGP) <- t$PhySpec
rownames(melt_simple) <-  melt_simple$PhySpec
melt_simple <- as.matrix(melt_simple)

g1 <- gt + geom_tippoint(data=gd$istip,aes(color=Phylum),size=2)
gheatmap(g1,randomHeatmap,offset=1, width=2,colnames_angle=-45,hjust=0,font.size = 2) 

metadata <- data.frame(paste("X",1:20,sep=""),"metadata" = rnorm(1:20),row.names = T)

you can use https://github.com/shaunpwilkinson/phylogram to convert dendrogram to phylo object and then use ggtree to visualize hierarchical clustering.
